instruction: Add all spotify-recommended R&B songs released in this or last year to a new "Spotify R&B Recommendations" playlist.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor helpers; phone.get_current_date_and_time (no login needed) is modeled to make the 'this or last year' threshold (release_date >= 2022-01-01) known before filtering. The recommended songs are placeholders: the true set and count are only known at runtime from paginated spotify.show_recommendations, and each one must be inspected with spotify.show_song (genre and release_date are not in the recommendation list). The static init facts (recommended / genre-rnb / released-recently) stand for world properties the agent discovers; the add-song action can only fire for songs that have been inspected and satisfy both filters, so non-qualifying recommendations (rec-song-3) can never be added, matching the evaluation that added PlaylistSong ids must equal exactly the qualifying set. Exactly one playlist titled 'Spotify R&B Recommendations' is created (create_playlist guarded by not-already-created). supervisor-complete-task takes the task records (playlist, title, the two qualifying songs) as non-API parameters so its precondition restates the goal conditions; the problem goal fixes the ground instances. The reference plan lists show_song once per recommendation (a real agent inspects all of them); a classical planner will omit the inspection of the non-qualifying placeholder since it is not needed for the goal. complete_task is called with status success and no answer.
